q: 我家___医院很近，走路五分钟就到。
zh: 我家离医院很近，走路五分钟就到。
py: wǒ jiā lí yī yuàn hěn jìn zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào
en: My home is close to the hospital; it is five minutes on foot.
why: 离 gives the distance between two fixed points and takes 很近. 从 marks a starting point of movement, so 我家从医院很近 is wrong.

q: 夏天___六月开始，一直到九月。
zh: 夏天从六月开始，一直到九月。
py: xià tiān cóng liù yuè kāi shǐ yì zhí dào jiǔ yuè
en: Summer starts in June and runs until September.
why: 从…到 frames a span of time: 从 gives the starting month. 离 measures a gap and cannot introduce the start of a period.

q: ___冬天还有两个月，天气还不太冷。
zh: 离冬天还有两个月，天气还不太冷。
py: lí dōng tiān hái yǒu liǎng gè yuè tiān qì hái bù tài lěng
en: There are still two months until winter, so it is not very cold yet.
why: 离…还有 + time counts the gap before an event. 从 would need a movement or a span with 到, and it cannot be followed by 还有.

q: 这儿___药店只有三百米，走过去很快。
zh: 这儿离药店只有三百米，走过去很快。
py: zhè r lí yào diàn zhǐ yǒu sān bǎi mǐ zǒu guò qù hěn kuài
en: It is only three hundred metres from here to the pharmacy; it is a quick walk.
why: 有 + distance describes the gap between two places, which is 离. 从 would make 这儿 a starting point of a movement and does not take 有 + distance.

q: 医生说我要___明天开始吃这种药，每天两次。
zh: 医生说我要从明天开始吃这种药，每天两次。
py: yī shēng shuō wǒ yào cóng míng tiān kāi shǐ chī zhè zhǒng yào měi tiān liǎng cì
en: The doctor says I have to start taking this medicine tomorrow, twice a day.
why: 从 + time + 开始 marks when a period begins. 离 would measure a gap between two points and cannot go with 开始 here.

q: ___我家到医院坐地铁只要二十分钟，所以我常去那儿锻炼身体。
zh: 从我家到医院坐地铁只要二十分钟，所以我常去那儿锻炼身体。
py: cóng wǒ jiā dào yī yuàn zuò dì tiě zhǐ yào èr shí fēn zhōng suǒ yǐ wǒ cháng qù nà r duàn liàn shēn tǐ
en: It only takes twenty minutes by subway from my home to the hospital, so I often go there to exercise.
why: A route with a start and an end is 从…到…. 离 does not pair with 到, so 离我家到医院 is ungrammatical.

q: 现在___下雪还有两个多月，你不用急着买羽绒服。
zh: 现在离下雪还有两个多月，你不用急着买羽绒服。
py: xiàn zài lí xià xuě hái yǒu liǎng gè duō yuè nǐ bù yòng jí zhe mǎi yǔ róng fú
en: There are still more than two months until it snows, so there is no hurry to buy a down jacket.
why: 离 + event + 还有 + time counts down to a future event. 从 cannot count the gap before something happens.

q: 台风昨天晚上___南边吹过来，风特别大。
zh: 台风昨天晚上从南边吹过来，风特别大。
py: tái fēng zuó tiān wǎn shang cóng nán biān chuī guò lái fēng tè bié dà
en: The typhoon blew in from the south last night, and the wind was very strong.
why: 从 + direction marks where the movement came from. 离 only measures a distance and has no movement; 对 and 给 need a person.

q: 我___早上到现在一直头疼。
zh: 我从早上到现在一直头疼。
py: wǒ cóng zǎo shang dào xiàn zài yì zhí tóu téng
en: I have had a headache all the time from this morning until now.
why: 从…到现在 gives the starting point of a time span. 离 needs a second point to measure the gap to; 在 cannot mark a starting time.

q: 太阳___东边慢慢升起来，雾也散了。
zh: 太阳从东边慢慢升起来，雾也散了。
py: tài yáng cóng dōng biān màn màn shēng qǐ lái wù yě sàn le
en: The sun slowly rose from the east and the fog cleared.
why: 从 + place marks where the movement begins. 往 would mean moving toward the east, the opposite meaning, and 离 has no movement.

q: 多晒太阳___身体好。
zh: 多晒太阳对身体好。
py: duō shài tài yáng duì shēn tǐ hǎo
en: Getting more sun is good for your health.
why: 对 marks what is affected, so 对身体好 means good for the body. 跟 marks a partner and 给 a recipient; neither fits an effect.

q: 弟弟发烧了，妈妈___老师打电话请假。
zh: 弟弟发烧了，妈妈给老师打电话请假。
py: dì di fā shāo le mā ma gěi lǎo shī dǎ diàn huà qǐng jià
en: My brother has a fever, so Mum phoned the teacher to ask for leave.
why: The person who receives a phone call is marked by 给 before 打电话. 对老师打电话 is not said.

q: 我___医生约好了明天上午见面。
zh: 我跟医生约好了明天上午见面。
py: wǒ gēn yī shēng yuē hǎo le míng tiān shàng wǔ jiàn miàn
en: I have arranged to meet the doctor tomorrow morning.
why: 见面 is mutual and cannot take an object, so the other person is marked by 跟 before it. 对 marks an attitude, not a partner.

q: 长期熬夜___心脏不好，你要早点儿睡。
zh: 长期熬夜对心脏不好，你要早点儿睡。
py: cháng qī áo yè duì xīn zàng bù hǎo nǐ yào zǎo diǎn r shuì
en: Staying up late for a long time is bad for the heart, so go to bed earlier.
why: 对 + body part + 不好 marks the thing affected. 给 would mean a recipient and 跟 a partner; neither marks an effect.

q: 她___运动一点儿也不感兴趣，更喜欢躺在沙发上。
zh: 她对运动一点儿也不感兴趣，更喜欢躺在沙发上。
py: tā duì yùn dòng yì diǎn r yě bù gǎn xìng qù gèng xǐ huan tǎng zài shā fā shàng
en: She is not the least bit interested in sport and prefers lying on the sofa.
why: 感兴趣 is an attitude toward something, so it takes 对. 向 needs a person or an abstract action like 学习, and 跟 means a partner.

q: 护士每天都___病人量体温。
zh: 护士每天都给病人量体温。
py: hù shi měi tiān dōu gěi bìng rén liáng tǐ wēn
en: The nurse takes each patient's temperature every day.
why: 给 marks the person a service is done for. 跟 would mean doing it together with the patient, which changes the meaning.

q: 我想___你聊聊最近的睡眠问题。
zh: 我想跟你聊聊最近的睡眠问题。
py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ liáo liáo zuì jìn de shuì mián wèn tí
en: I would like to chat with you about my recent sleep problems.
why: 聊 is a two-way activity, so the partner takes 跟. 给 would make you a recipient of a one-way action, and 往 needs a direction.

q: 医生___我说，这个病不严重。
zh: 医生对我说，这个病不严重。
py: yī shēng duì wǒ shuō zhè ge bìng bù yán zhòng
en: The doctor said to me that the illness is not serious.
why: 说 with a listener takes 对 (or 跟) before the verb. 往 and 从 mark direction or origin and cannot introduce a listener.

q: 下雨天我___朋友通了很长时间的电话。
zh: 下雨天我跟朋友通了很长时间的电话。
py: xià yǔ tiān wǒ gēn péng you tōng le hěn cháng shí jiān de diàn huà
en: On the rainy day I talked on the phone with a friend for a long time.
why: 通电话 is mutual, so the partner takes 跟. 对 would mark an attitude toward the friend, not the person you talk with.

q: 多喝热水___缓解感冒症状很有帮助。
zh: 多喝热水对缓解感冒症状很有帮助。
py: duō hē rè shuǐ duì huǎn jiě gǎn mào zhèng zhuàng hěn yǒu bāng zhù
en: Drinking more hot water is very helpful for relieving cold symptoms.
why: 有帮助 is an effect on something, so 对 marks what is helped. 给 is for a recipient and 从 for a starting point.

q: 出了医院，___右拐就是药店。
zh: 出了医院，往右拐就是药店。
py: chū le yī yuàn wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì yào diàn
en: Once you are out of the hospital, turn right and the pharmacy is there.
why: 往 + direction + movement verb 拐 gives the direction of travel. 从 would mean starting from the right, and 对 and 给 need a person.

q: 过马路时请先___左右看看。
zh: 过马路时请先往左右看看。
py: guò mǎ lù shí qǐng xiān wǎng zuǒ yòu kàn kàn
en: Please look left and right first when crossing the road.
why: 往 + direction + a verb of looking or going. 对 and 给 need a person, and 离 measures a distance.

q: 我要___医生请教一下怎么控制血压。
zh: 我要向医生请教一下怎么控制血压。
py: wǒ yào xiàng yī shēng qǐng jiào yī xià zěn me kòng zhì xuè yā
en: I want to ask the doctor how to control my blood pressure.
why: 向 + person goes with abstract verbs of asking and learning like 请教. 往 needs a place or direction, and 从 would mean a source of movement.

q: 孩子笑着___妈妈跑了过去。
zh: 孩子笑着朝妈妈跑了过去。
py: hái zi xiào zhe cháo mā ma pǎo le guò qù
en: The child ran toward Mum, smiling.
why: 朝 + person marks the direction faced in a movement. 从妈妈 would mean running away from Mum, and 对 and 给 do not mark a direction of running.

q: 风是从北边吹来的，我们___南走就不会那么冷。
zh: 风是从北边吹来的，我们往南走就不会那么冷。
py: fēng shì cóng běi biān chuī lái de wǒ men wǎng nán zǒu jiù bú huì nà me lěng
en: The wind is blowing from the north, so if we go south it will not be so cold.
why: 往 + direction + 走 marks where you head. 从南走 would mean leaving from the south, and 离 and 对 do not mark a direction.

q: 我们应该___运动员学习，每天坚持锻炼。
zh: 我们应该向运动员学习，每天坚持锻炼。
py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng yùn dòng yuán xué xí měi tiān jiān chí duàn liàn
en: We should learn from athletes and keep exercising every day.
why: 学习 needs 向 for the person you learn from. 往 needs a direction or place, and 对 or 给 cannot mark a teacher.

q: 你一直___前走，药店就在医院旁边。
zh: 你一直往前走，药店就在医院旁边。
py: nǐ yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu yào diàn jiù zài yī yuàn páng biān
en: Keep going straight ahead; the pharmacy is next to the hospital.
why: 往 + direction + 走 describes the direction of walking. 从前走 would not make sense, and 对 and 给 need a person.

q: 听说你的病好了，我真___你高兴。
zh: 听说你的病好了，我真为你高兴。
py: tīng shuō nǐ de bìng hǎo le wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
en: I heard you are better; I am really happy for you.
why: 为 marks the person on whose account you feel something. 对你高兴 and 给你高兴 are not said.

q: 外面下着大雨，妈妈很___我担心。
zh: 外面下着大雨，妈妈很为我担心。
py: wài miàn xià zhe dà yǔ mā ma hěn wèi wǒ dān xīn
en: It is pouring outside and Mum is very worried about me.
why: 为 marks the person behind a worry, so 为我担心. 往 and 从 mark direction and cannot carry a feeling.

q: 我感冒了，你可以___我去药店买药吗？
zh: 我感冒了，你可以替我去药店买药吗？
py: wǒ gǎn mào le nǐ kě yǐ tì wǒ qù yào diàn mǎi yào ma
en: I have a cold; can you go to the pharmacy in my place and buy some medicine?
why: 替 means doing something in someone else's place so that they do not have to. 对 marks an attitude and 往 and 离 are about direction and distance.

q: 明天我发烧去不了公司，你能___我请一天假吗？
zh: 明天我发烧去不了公司，你能替我请一天假吗？
py: míng tiān wǒ fā shāo qù bù liǎo gōng sī nǐ néng tì wǒ qǐng yī tiān jiǎ ma
en: I have a fever and cannot go to the office tomorrow; could you ask for a day off on my behalf?
why: 替我请假 means asking for leave on my behalf. 跟我请假 would mean asking me for leave, the opposite relation.

q: 医生们日夜工作，___大家的健康服务。
zh: 医生们日夜工作，为大家的健康服务。
py: yī shēng men rì yè gōng zuò wèi dà jiā de jiàn kāng fú wù
en: The doctors work day and night to serve everyone's health.
why: 为 marks the people you serve, as in 为大家服务. 对 would give an attitude, not a beneficiary.

q: 听到爷爷的手术很顺利，全家人都___他高兴。
zh: 听到爷爷的手术很顺利，全家人都为他高兴。
py: tīng dào yé ye de shǒu shù hěn shùn lì quán jiā rén dōu wèi tā gāo xìng
en: Hearing that Grandpa's operation went smoothly, the whole family was happy for him.
why: 为 marks the person you feel happy on behalf of. 对他高兴 is not said, and 从 and 往 mark direction.

q: 我感冒了，不能___冷水洗脸。
zh: 我感冒了，不能用冷水洗脸。
py: wǒ gǎn mào le bù néng yòng lěng shuǐ xǐ liǎn
en: I have a cold and must not wash my face with cold water.
why: 用 marks the tool or material used. 坐, 骑 and 开 are for vehicles, not for water.

q: 下大雪，今天我们别骑车了，___公交车去医院吧。
zh: 下大雪，今天我们别骑车了，坐公交车去医院吧。
py: xià dà xuě jīn tiān wǒ men bié qí chē le zuò gōng jiāo chē qù yī yuàn ba
en: It is snowing hard, so let us not cycle today but take the bus to the hospital.
why: 坐 + vehicle means travel as a passenger. 开 would mean driving the bus yourself, and 骑 is for bikes.

q: 医生___一个小仪器检查我的耳朵。
zh: 医生用一个小仪器检查我的耳朵。
py: yī shēng yòng yí gè xiǎo yí qì jiǎn chá wǒ de ěr duǒ
en: The doctor examined my ear with a small instrument.
why: 用 + tool states the instrument used before the verb. 坐 is for vehicles and 给 would need a person.

q: 天气好的时候，我喜欢___自行车去公园锻炼身体。
zh: 天气好的时候，我喜欢骑自行车去公园锻炼身体。
py: tiān qì hǎo de shí hou wǒ xǐ huan qí zì xíng chē qù gōng yuán duàn liàn shēn tǐ
en: When the weather is nice, I like to ride my bike to the park to exercise.
why: Bicycles are ridden, so 骑. 开 is for cars you drive and 坐 for being a passenger; 往 is not a vehicle verb.

q: 医生让我___温水吃药，不要用茶。
zh: 医生让我用温水吃药，不要用茶。
py: yī shēng ràng wǒ yòng wēn shuǐ chī yào bú yào yòng chá
en: The doctor told me to take the medicine with warm water, not with tea.
why: 用 + material states what you take the medicine with. 给 and 对 need a person, and 坐 is for vehicles.

q: 夏天中午我___外面跑步，太热了。
zh: 夏天中午我不在外面跑步，太热了。
py: xià tiān zhōng wǔ wǒ bù zài wài miàn pǎo bù tài rè le
en: In summer at noon I do not run outside; it is too hot.
why: 不 goes before the coverb phrase with an action verb: 不在外面跑步. 在不外面 breaks the phrase, and 对 and 给 need a person.

q: 他昨天___我打电话，所以我不知道他病了。
zh: 他昨天没给我打电话，所以我不知道他病了。
py: tā zuó tiān méi gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà suǒ yǐ wǒ bù zhī dao tā bìng le
en: He did not call me yesterday, so I did not know he was ill.
why: 没 goes before 给 and denies the past action. 不给 is not used for a single past event, and 给没我 breaks the phrase.

q: 这家医院离地铁站___，走路五分钟就到。
zh: 这家医院离地铁站不远，走路五分钟就到。
py: zhè jiā yī yuàn lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào
en: This hospital is not far from the subway station; it is five minutes on foot.
why: 远 is an adjective, so 不 goes right before it after the 离 phrase. 不近 would contradict 'five minutes on foot', and 没远 is not used.

q: 我对猫毛过敏，我妹妹___对猫毛过敏。
zh: 我对猫毛过敏，我妹妹也对猫毛过敏。
py: wǒ duì māo máo guò mǐn wǒ mèi mei yě duì māo máo guò mǐn
en: I am allergic to cat hair and my younger sister is allergic to it too.
why: 也 adds a second person with the same property and goes before 对. 都 needs a plural subject, and 更 and 才 do not mean 'also'.

q: 医生把检查结果发___我了，你看看邮箱。
zh: 医生把检查结果发给我了，你看看邮箱。
py: yī shēng bǎ jiǎn chá jié guǒ fā gěi wǒ le nǐ kàn kàn yóu xiāng
en: The doctor sent me the test results; check your email.
why: The recipient of a sent thing attaches to 发 as 给. 发在我 and 发到我 do not work with a person as the endpoint.

q: 雨太大了，哥哥开车把我送___医院。
zh: 雨太大了，哥哥开车把我送到医院。
py: yǔ tài dà le gē ge kāi chē bǎ wǒ sòng dào yī yuàn
en: It was raining too hard, so my brother drove me to the hospital.
why: 送到 + place says where the person ends up. 送在 and 送给 do not fit a place.

q: 他累得一躺___床上就睡着了。
zh: 他累得一躺在床上就睡着了。
py: tā lèi de yī tǎng zài chuáng shàng jiù shuì zháo le
en: He was so tired that he fell asleep as soon as he lay down on the bed.
why: 躺在 + place says where the body ends up lying. 给 and 对 need a person, and 往 cannot be glued to the verb here.

q: 请把你的症状写___这张纸上。
zh: 请把你的症状写在这张纸上。
py: qǐng bǎ nǐ de zhèng zhuàng xiě zài zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng
en: Please write your symptoms on this sheet of paper.
why: 写在 + surface marks where the writing ends up. 给 and 跟 mark people.

q: 医生把药方交___护士，护士去拿药。
zh: 医生把药方交给护士，护士去拿药。
py: yī shēng bǎ yào fāng jiāo gěi hù shi hù shi qù ná yào
en: The doctor handed the prescription to the nurse, and the nurse went to fetch the medicine.
why: 交给 + person marks who receives the thing. 交在 and 交到 need a place, not a person.

q: 冬天太冷了，妈妈把爷爷接___我们家住了一个月。
zh: 冬天太冷了，妈妈把爷爷接到我们家住了一个月。
py: dōng tiān tài lěng le mā ma bǎ yé ye jiē dào wǒ men jiā zhù le yí gè yuè
en: It was too cold in winter, so Mum brought Grandpa to our home for a month.
why: 接到 + place says where the person was brought. 接在 and 接给 do not mark a destination.

q: 她把退烧药还___了邻居，因为已经用不着了。
zh: 她把退烧药还给了邻居，因为已经用不着了。
py: tā bǎ tuì shāo yào huán gěi le lín jū yīn wèi yǐ jīng yòng bù zháo le
en: She returned the fever medicine to the neighbour because she no longer needed it.
why: 还给 + person gives the person it is returned to, followed by 了. 还在 would read as "still at" and 还到 needs a place.

q: 她把湿衣服挂___阳台上晾干。
zh: 她把湿衣服挂在阳台上晾干。
py: tā bǎ shī yī fu guà zài yáng tái shàng liàng gān
en: She hung the wet clothes on the balcony to dry.
why: 挂在 + place says where the clothes end up hanging. 给 and 跟 mark people.

q: 冬天我们常常___暖气房间里喝热茶。
zh: 冬天我们常常在暖气房间里喝热茶。
py: dōng tiān wǒ men cháng cháng zài nuǎn qì fáng jiān lǐ hē rè chá
en: In winter we often drink hot tea in a heated room.
why: The place where an activity happens takes 在 before the verb. 对 and 给 need a person.

q: 病人___病房里休息，请不要打扰。
zh: 病人在病房里休息，请不要打扰。
py: bìng rén zài bìng fáng lǐ xiū xi qǐng bú yào dǎ rǎo
en: The patient is resting in the ward; please do not disturb.
why: 在 + place marks where the resting happens. 跟 would mean resting with someone and 从 marks a starting point.

q: 下雨天他喜欢___朋友一起在咖啡馆看书。
zh: 下雨天他喜欢跟朋友一起在咖啡馆看书。
py: xià yǔ tiān tā xǐ huan gēn péng you yì qǐ zài kā fēi guǎn kàn shū
en: On rainy days he likes to read in a café together with friends.
why: 跟 + person + 一起 marks the companion before the verb. 对 and 给 do not mean doing something together.

zh: 弟弟在医院看病。
py: dì di zài yī yuàn kàn bìng
en: My brother is seeing a doctor at the hospital.
why: The place of the activity goes before the verb: 在医院看病. Putting 在医院 after 看病 is the English order and is wrong.

zh: 下雨天我跟妈妈在家包饺子。
py: xià yǔ tiān wǒ gēn mā ma zài jiā bāo jiǎo zi
en: On rainy days I make dumplings at home with Mum.
why: Both the companion and the place stand before the verb, in either order. Neither can follow 包饺子.

zh: 我坐地铁去医院。
py: wǒ zuò dì tiě qù yī yuàn
en: I go to the hospital by subway.
why: 坐 + vehicle comes first, then the movement 去医院.

zh: 他昨天没给我打电话。
py: tā zuó tiān méi gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
en: He did not call me yesterday.
why: 没 goes before the coverb phrase with an action verb. 给我没打电话 is wrong.

zh: 这家医院离地铁站不远。
py: zhè jiā yī yuàn lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn
en: This hospital is not far from the subway station.
why: 远 is an adjective, so 不 sits right before it, after the 离 phrase.

zh: 我也想跟你们一起去爬山。
py: wǒ yě xiǎng gēn nǐ men yì qǐ qù pá shān
en: I want to go hiking with you too.
why: 也 and the modal 想 go before the 跟 phrase, and 一起去 follows it. 跟你们 cannot come after 爬山.

zh: 从这里到公园要十分钟。
py: cóng zhè lǐ dào gōng yuán yào shí fēn zhōng
en: It takes ten minutes from here to the park.
why: 从…到… frames a route, with 从 first and 到 after. 离 does not pair with 到.

zh: 离春天还有一个月。
py: lí chūn tiān hái yǒu yí gè yuè
en: There is still a month until spring.
why: 离 + event + 还有 + time counts the gap before something. 从 cannot do this.

zh: 过了红绿灯往左拐就到医院了。
py: guò le hóng lǜ dēng wǎng zuǒ guǎi jiù dào yī yuàn le
en: Turn left after the traffic lights and you will be at the hospital.
why: 往 + direction goes before the movement verb 拐. 往左 cannot follow 拐.

zh: 听到好消息我真为你高兴。
py: tīng dào hǎo xiāo xi wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
en: I was really happy for you when I heard the good news.
why: 为你 goes before the feeling word 高兴. 高兴为你 is not possible.

zh: 你能替我去药店买药吗。
py: nǐ néng tì wǒ qù yào diàn mǎi yào ma
en: Can you go to the pharmacy and buy medicine for me?
why: 替我 means in my place and goes before the verb it governs, so it can sit before or after 去药店. 吗 closes the question.

zh: 妈妈把药放在桌子上。
py: mā ma bǎ yào fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
en: Mum put the medicine on the table.
why: 放在 is glued together, with the place after it. The object moves forward with 把.

zh: 哥哥把我送到医院了。
py: gē ge bǎ wǒ sòng dào yī yuàn le
en: My brother took me to the hospital.
why: 送到 + place says where the person ends up. 了 comes at the end of the whole unit.

zh: 医生对我说多喝水对身体好。
py: yī shēng duì wǒ shuō duō hē shuǐ duì shēn tǐ hǎo
en: The doctor said to me that drinking more water is good for the body.
why: 对我 goes before 说, and 对身体好 is a second 对 phrase inside the quoted idea.

zh: 我晚上给妈妈打电话。
py: wǒ wǎn shang gěi mā ma dǎ diàn huà
en: I call my mother in the evening.
why: The receiver 给妈妈 goes before 打电话. 打电话给妈妈 is a different structure and not part of this drill.

src_py: wǒ zuó tiān gěi tā dǎ diàn huà le
zh: 我昨天没给他打电话。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi gěi tā dǎ diàn huà
en: I did not call him yesterday.
why: 没 goes before 给他 and replaces 了. 给他没打电话 is wrong.

src_py: zhè jiā yào diàn lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn
zh: 这家药店离我家不近。
py: zhè jiā yào diàn lí wǒ jiā bù jìn
en: This pharmacy is not close to my home.
why: 近 is an adjective, so 不 replaces 很 right before it, after the 离 phrase.

src_py: wǒ gēn péng you qù pá shān
zh: 我也跟朋友去爬山。
py: wǒ yě gēn péng you qù pá shān
en: I am going hiking with a friend too.
why: 也 goes before the coverb phrase 跟朋友, not before 爬山.

src_py: tā zài yī yuàn gōng zuò
zh: 他不在医院工作。
py: tā bù zài yī yuàn gōng zuò
en: He does not work at the hospital.
why: 不 goes before 在医院, not between 在医院 and 工作.

src_py: tā men yòng zhōng yào zhì gǎn mào
task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
zh: 他们用中药治感冒吗？
py: tā men yòng zhōng yào zhì gǎn mào ma
en: Do they treat colds with traditional Chinese medicine?
why: 吗 closes the sentence; 用中药 stays before the verb 治.

zh: 我为他担心。
py: wǒ wèi tā dān xīn
en: I worry about him.
why: 为 + person goes before 担心 and marks the person the worry is about.

src_py: hē rè shuǐ duì gǎn mào yǒu bāng zhù
zh: 喝热水对感冒没有帮助。
py: hē rè shuǐ duì gǎn mào méi yǒu bāng zhù
en: Drinking hot water is not helpful for a cold.
why: The 对 phrase stays before 有, and 没 replaces it as 没有. 对感冒 cannot move after 帮助.

src_py: xiàng zuǒ guǎi jiù shì yī yuàn
zh: 往左拐就是医院。
py: wǎng zuǒ guǎi jiù shì yī yuàn
en: Turn left and that is the hospital.
why: 往 + direction + movement verb 拐 is the standard way to give a direction, and the phrase stays before the verb.

src_py: wǒ bǎ yào fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
zh: 我没把药放在桌子上。
py: wǒ méi bǎ yào fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
en: I did not put the medicine on the table.
why: 没 goes before 把, not before 放在, and 了 is dropped.

src: 妈妈寄了那件羽绒服给我。
src_py: mā ma jì le nà jiàn yǔ róng fú gěi wǒ
zh: 妈妈把那件羽绒服寄给我了。
py: mā ma bǎ nà jiàn yǔ róng fú jì gěi wǒ le
en: Mum sent me that down jacket.
why: The definite object moves after 把, and 寄给 + person stays glued together with 了 at the end.

s: 我吃药在家里。
s_py: wǒ chī yào zài jiā lǐ
zh: 我在家里吃药。
py: wǒ zài jiā lǐ chī yào
en: I take my medicine at home.
why: The place must come before the verb: 在家里 stands in front of 吃药. English puts the place last, but Chinese does not.

s: 他明天见面医生。
s_py: tā míng tiān jiàn miàn yī shēng
zh: 他明天跟医生见面。
py: tā míng tiān gēn yī shēng jiàn miàn
en: He is meeting the doctor tomorrow.
why: 见面 cannot take an object. The other person is marked by 跟 before the verb.

s: 我给朋友没发信息。
s_py: wǒ gěi péng you méi fā xìn xī
zh: 我没给朋友发信息。
py: wǒ méi gěi péng you fā xìn xī
en: I did not send my friend a message.
why: 没 must come before the coverb phrase 给朋友, not between it and the verb 发.

s: 这家医院不离我家远。
s_py: zhè jiā yī yuàn bù lí wǒ jiā yuǎn
zh: 这家医院离我家不远。
py: zhè jiā yī yuàn lí wǒ jiā bù yuǎn
en: This hospital is not far from my home.
why: 远 is an adjective, so 不 goes right before it: 离我家不远. 不离 is not said.

s: 离医院到我家要半小时。
s_py: lí yī yuàn dào wǒ jiā yào bàn xiǎo shí
zh: 从医院到我家要半小时。
py: cóng yī yuàn dào wǒ jiā yào bàn xiǎo shí
en: It takes half an hour from the hospital to my home.
why: A route with a start and an end is 从…到…. 离 measures a gap and does not combine with 到.

s: 我跟中医很感兴趣。
s_py: wǒ gēn zhōng yī hěn gǎn xìng qù
zh: 我对中医很感兴趣。
py: wǒ duì zhōng yī hěn gǎn xìng qù
en: I am very interested in traditional Chinese medicine.
why: 感兴趣 is an attitude toward something, so it takes 对. 跟 marks a partner in a mutual activity.

s: 他们往老医生学习。
s_py: tā men wǎng lǎo yī shēng xué xí
zh: 他们向老医生学习。
py: tā men xiàng lǎo yī shēng xué xí
en: They learn from the old doctor.
why: With a person and the abstract verb 学习 only 向 is possible. 往 needs a place or direction.

s: 她往我笑了笑。
s_py: tā wǎng wǒ xiào le xiào
zh: 她朝我笑了笑。
py: tā cháo wǒ xiào le xiào
en: She gave me a smile.
why: 往 needs a direction and real movement. Facing a person with a smile takes 朝 or 向.

s: 我担心为他。
s_py: wǒ dān xīn wèi tā
zh: 我为他担心。
py: wǒ wèi tā dān xīn
en: I worry about him.
why: 为 + person must come before the verb. Putting 为他 after 担心 is the English order.

s: 我们用公共汽车去医院。
s_py: wǒ men yòng gōng gòng qì chē qù yī yuàn
zh: 我们坐公共汽车去医院。
py: wǒ men zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù yī yuàn
en: We take the bus to the hospital.
why: Vehicles take 坐 (or 骑 for bikes). 用 is for tools and materials.

s: 他把湿外套挂了在椅子上。
s_py: tā bǎ shī wài tào guà le zài yǐ zi shàng
zh: 他把湿外套挂在椅子上了。
py: tā bǎ shī wài tào guà zài yǐ zi shàng le
en: He hung the wet coat on the chair.
why: 在 attaches directly to the verb: 挂在. 了 cannot come between them and goes after the whole unit.

s: 我把他送在医院了。
s_py: wǒ bǎ tā sòng zài yī yuàn le
zh: 我把他送到医院了。
py: wǒ bǎ tā sòng dào yī yuàn le
en: I took him to the hospital.
why: 送 + place that he travels to needs 到, not 在. 送在 would describe a static position.

s: 我在医院旁边住了三年。
s_py: wǒ zài yī yuàn páng biān zhù le sān nián
zh: 我在医院旁边住了三年。
py: wǒ zài yī yuàn páng biān zhù le sān nián
en: I lived next to the hospital for three years.
why: 住 is one of the few verbs that allows the place before it as well as after (住在医院旁边), so this is correct.

s: 医生对每个病人都很耐心。
s_py: yī shēng duì měi gè bìng rén dōu hěn nài xīn
zh: 医生对每个病人都很耐心。
py: yī shēng duì měi gè bìng rén dōu hěn nài xīn
en: The doctor is patient with every patient.
why: 都 stays before the predicate after the 对 phrase because 耐心 is a state, and this is fine. Nothing needs to be moved.

s: 这个周末的天气跟上周一样冷。
s_py: zhè ge zhōu mò de tiān qì gēn shàng zhōu yī yàng lěng
zh: 这个周末的天气跟上周一样冷。
py: zhè ge zhōu mò de tiān qì gēn shàng zhōu yī yàng lěng
en: This weekend's weather is as cold as last week's.
why: 跟…一样 + adjective is the normal pattern, with the 跟 phrase before the predicate. Nothing is wrong.

s: 我对花粉过敏，对猫毛不过敏。
s_py: wǒ duì huā fěn guò mǐn duì māo máo bù guò mǐn
zh: 我对花粉过敏，对猫毛不过敏。
py: wǒ duì huā fěn guò mǐn duì māo máo bù guò mǐn
en: I am allergic to pollen but not to cat hair.
why: 不 goes right on the predicate 过敏, after 对猫毛. This is correct.

s: 我们应该向医生请教这个问题。
s_py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng yī shēng qǐng jiào zhè ge wèn tí
zh: 我们应该向医生请教这个问题。
py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng yī shēng qǐng jiào zhè ge wèn tí
en: We should ask the doctor about this question.
why: 向 + person goes with the abstract verb 请教, and the phrase comes before the verb. This is correct.

s: 我从昨天晚上开始咳嗽。
s_py: wǒ cóng zuó tiān wǎn shang kāi shǐ ké sòu
zh: 我从昨天晚上开始咳嗽。
py: wǒ cóng zuó tiān wǎn shang kāi shǐ ké sòu
en: I have been coughing since last night.
why: 从 + time + 开始 marks where a period starts. It is correct, and 离 would not work here.

s: 她朝窗外看了看，说下雨了。
s_py: tā cháo chuāng wài kàn le kàn shuō xià yǔ le
zh: 她朝窗外看了看，说下雨了。
py: tā cháo chuāng wài kàn le kàn shuō xià yǔ le
en: She looked out of the window and said it was raining.
why: 朝 + place + a verb of looking is correct; it is the direction she faced.

s: 夏天我从来不用冷水洗澡。
s_py: xià tiān wǒ cóng lái bù yòng lěng shuǐ xǐ zǎo
zh: 夏天我从来不用冷水洗澡。
py: xià tiān wǒ cóng lái bù yòng lěng shuǐ xǐ zǎo
en: In summer I never wash with cold water.
why: 不 goes before 用冷水, and 用 marks the material used. This is correct.

q: 他从小就___运动很感兴趣，所以身体一直都很健康。
zh: 他从小就对运动很感兴趣，所以身体一直都很健康。
py: tā cóng xiǎo jiù duì yùn dòng hěn gǎn xìng qù suǒ yǐ shēn tǐ yì zhí dōu hěn jiàn kāng
en: He has been very interested in sport since he was little, so he has always been healthy.
why: 感兴趣 is an attitude toward something, so 对 marks the object of interest. 跟 would mean a partner and 给 a recipient.

q: 因为下大雨，路上特别堵，所以我们决定___地铁去机场。
zh: 因为下大雨，路上特别堵，所以我们决定坐地铁去机场。
py: yīn wèi xià dà yǔ lù shàng tè bié dǔ suǒ yǐ wǒ men jué dìng zuò dì tiě qù jī chǎng
en: Because of the heavy rain the roads were jammed, so we decided to take the subway to the airport.
why: The subway is a vehicle you ride as a passenger, so 坐. 开 would mean driving it, and 用 is for tools.
